live_rows.tail: any a request for certification of a batch of color additive is taken, the batch shall be:
(a) Stored in containers of such kind as to prevent change in composition.
(b) Held under the control of the person requesting certification until certified.
and no question that it is not to be used until the requested certificate has been issued.
